items.title: Why Microsoft, Amazon, & other Big Tech stocks are soaring post-earnings
items.summary: Big Tech stocks are soaring after the companies reported earnings last week, namely Microsoft (MSFT) and Amazon (AMZN). Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley takes a closer look.

items.title: Open-weight AI models add new spark to China, Silicon Valley's AI race
items.summary: Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Ines Ferré and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to assess and discuss the rising competition between open-weight AI models from China — which are public to download and modify — and Silicon Valley's top artificial intelligence developers.

items.title: Tech stock investors have a $1 trillion problem that won't improve until at least 2028
items.summary: Tech investors hoping for less robust AI spending may have to wait until 2028 before the fog lifts on this balance sheet line item.

items.title: ASTS Stock Hits Nearly 3-Week High: Meta Exec Teases WhatsApp Over Satellite Ahead Of BlueBird Launch
items.summary: BlueBird satellites 11-13 are scheduled to launch on Wednesday aboard a Falcon 9.

items.title: NYU Professor Says Watch Smaller AI Stocks When The Shakeout Hits
items.summary: Aswath Damodaran warns smaller AI stocks face a shakeout as Big Tech's cash flow protects Magnificent Seven giants.

items.title: METU’s a 2X Wager That Zuckerberg’s Billion-Dollar AI Bet Pays Off
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg is pouring over $130 billion into AI infrastructure, and one leveraged ETF bets those dollars will double your returns. But the mechanics behind that promise carry a risk most investors never see coming.

items.title: The Sharpest Exchanges From META's Earnings Call
items.summary: Meta's ad business is on fire, but on its latest earnings call, analysts kept probing the large, open-ended bill for its AI future, and management’s answers revealed the real risk.

items.title: META, GOOGL Stocks In Focus — White House Plans Meeting With Tech Giants On Tuesday Over AI Safety Tests, Says Report
items.summary: Apart from Google and Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic were also reportedly invited to discuss voluntary AI safety testing with White House officials.
